breakdown.description: The two concentrated loads are replaced by a distributed couple over a boundary segment
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified representing the two horizontal point loads as a 'self-equilibrated distributed couple acting over the short right-edge segment between y = 0.2 and y = 0.3.' The generated specification correctly resolves this by applying 'two concentrated point loads using dolfin PointSource on the x-displacement component: Fx = -3000 N at (1, 0.2) and Fx = +3000 N at (1, 0.3),' which matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Apply the two horizontal point loads as equal and opposite PointSource terms at the two stated boundary locations.'
